name: Parosh
overview: Parosh, also known as Pharosh, is identified in Scripture as the ancestor of one of the families that returned to Jerusalem from Babylonian captivity. The genealogical records in Ezra and Nehemiah highlight the significant number of Parosh's descendants who participated in the restoration of Jerusalem, with over two thousand individuals noted in Ezra 2:3 and Nehemiah 7:8. These passages emphasize the faithfulness and commitment of Parosh's lineage in reestablishing the community and covenant life after exile.
